# Krishna GSVV — AI Context

## About
B.Tech Computer Science graduate of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham (CGPA: 8.63/10, graduated Jul 2026), based in India and open to relocation. I build full-stack applications and AI systems that solve real problems — from browser extensions to deep learning pipelines. Right now I'm a software intern at Fission Labs, working an AI and Python stack. I started in core Python, moved to FastAPI to build services, backed those with PostgreSQL and designed the REST APIs on top of them, and I'm now on retrieval-augmented generation — including docs-rag, a pipeline that answers strictly from the documents it is given and cites the passages it used. I've competed at the national level and won five times: 1st at the IIT Hyderabad Pathway Hackathon, 1st runner-up at IIT Delhi CodeHive (₹1,00,000), 2nd runner-up at Tredence InfinityAI 2025 (₹2,00,000), 1st runner-up at ITM Gwalior's Code Kurukshetra with MomCare (₹35,000), and 1st at the Microsoft Imagine Cup campus round — ₹3.55L in prizes across 2025. On the research side, my deep learning work on diabetic retinopathy prediction is published on IEEE, and the EquiLens bias-detection corpus is released on Zenodo. I maintain open-source tools people actually use — cSpell Sync has 2,500+ VS Code Marketplace installs, and I'm LeetCode 150+ with HackerRank 5-star Python & SQL. My stack centers on React, Python, Node.js, and cloud (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, OCI Certified Architect Associate). Whether it's a VS Code extension, an ML pipeline, or a blockchain gateway — I care about code that's clean, fast, and worth shipping.

## Projects (19 total)
- **RanobeGemini**: Browser extension enhancing web novel translations using Google's Gemini AI. Transforms poorly translated content on popular novel sites with one click.
- **ToxicGuard_AI**: ToxiGuard AI is a browser extension that detects and censors toxic language in real-time using TensorFlow.js. It offers fine-grained controls, visual feedback, auto-censor, adjustable sensitivity, and respects user privacy.
- **EquiLens**: AI Bias Detection Platform for LLMs via Ollama. Interactive CLI with corpus generation, multi-metric auditing, statistical analysis & visualization. Features enhanced auditors, dynamic concurrency, resume capability & rich progress tracking.
- **Save-Sync**: VS Code Extension to save your project at working save points.
- **CFlair-Counter**: Ultra-efficient serverless view counter with admin panel and SVG badges. Optimized for Cloudflare's free tier with headless telemetry tracking.
- **the-pensive-index**: Library-first fanfiction discovery platform with hierarchical tagging and intelligent prompt generation. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Spec-Driven Development.
- **cspell-sync**: cspell-sync: VS Code extension syncing project spelling dictionaries with global settings for consistent spell checking across workspaces.
- **Facial-Emotion-Detector**: Facial emotion detection using MediaPipe and machine learning. Extract facial landmarks, train models, and classify emotions in real-time from images and videos.
- **ActionsCounter**: GitHub Actions workflow tracker and analytics dashboard for CI/CD monitoring, deployment tracking, and webhook integration.
- **SignLanguageDetector**: Sign Language Detector is a real-time ISL recognition system. It uses OpenCV and MediaPipe for hand tracking, a machine learning classifier for gesture recognition, and a Flask web interface for live inference.
